title: SHARP NFL Week 8 Bets: Ravens-Bills, Chiefs-Broncos, Browns-Steelers, Bucs-Falcons, Vikings-Lions
transcript_summary: Chad Millman and Simon Hunter break down the NFL Week 8 betting slate on Sharp or Square, analyzing line movement, pro money, and sharp calls. They deliver their top best bets, including the Panthers, Cardinals, Vikings, Jets (Brass Balls), and Broncos.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Welcome to Sharp or Square, presented by Polymarket, part of The Volume Podcast Network. I am Chad Millman, joined as always by professional bettor Simon Hunter.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Chad, how are we doing?

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Sports are the best. Reflecting on the Milwaukee Brewers World Series run and how special it is for fans in Milwaukee like Matt Mitchell and his son.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: It was a can't-lose World Series with two franchise fan bases that never won. Remembering Bob Uecker and how legendary he was for Milwaukee.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Breaking news right before we came on air: the Chicago Bears traded two first-round picks and a fourth-round pick for defensive lineman Jeffrey Simmons. I love the guts and risk-taking for the Bears.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: I don't hate it because he's a great player at a key position, but the window is open for the next 10-15 years with Caleb Williams. You don't necessarily have to sell all draft picks on rookie contract logic.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Discussing Peter King's new book 'The Game' and fact-checking Peter King early in my sports journalism career.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Peter King's book is a masterclass in NFL journalism. Also correcting two points from earlier: Jared Goff is actually great against the blitz this season, and Baker Mayfield hurt his throwing hand.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Previewing the segment overview for Week 8 NFL games.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Sharp Calls segment: Pros are split on Green Bay vs Carolina; heavy pro interest taking Ravens +3.5; Jets line flipped from +1.5 to -1.5 against Raiders; pro money on Pittsburgh; Jaguars steam up to -10 vs Colts; pro money on Broncos over Chiefs.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Panthers at Packers (-3.5). Carolina is a classic bounce-back underdog spot off a blowout loss.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Agree on Carolina +3.5. Bryce Young bounces back consistently after bad losses.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Cardinals at Cowboys (-7). Taking Arizona +7. Dallas hasn't proven they can lay a touchdown.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Arizona has historically owned Dallas in recent matchups, winning in 2020, 2022, 2023, and 2024. Dallas defense is too vulnerable.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Vikings at Lions (-3.5). Betting Minnesota +3.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Simon Says bet: Minnesota +3.5. Detroit defense is 28th on 3rd down and 32nd in pass yards allowed, while Minnesota defense is elite.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Falcons at Bucs (-2.5). 81% of public money is on Atlanta, but line hasn't moved.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Tampa Bay -2.5 is a strong situational spot at home under 3. Bucs defense has turned things around.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Brass Balls Trade of the Week: New York Jets -1.5 against Las Vegas Raiders.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Jets defense should dominate Raiders' offense that lacks a consistent run game with Gentry/Love.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Browns at Steelers (-3.5). Liking Cleveland +3.5 coming off Pittsburgh's international travel.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Steelers coming off travel, Browns' young drafted talent is clicking.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Addressing listener feedback about grammar ('Chad and I') and trolling Simon with Peter King's book.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Ravens at Bills (-3). Sharp money moved line from 3.5 to 3 on Baltimore.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Taking Ravens +3.5. Buffalo defense gets run over late in games.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Chargers at Rams (-6.5). Passing on Chargers unless line gets back to 7 or 7.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Chiefs (-1.5) at Broncos. Mahomes as a heavy public favorite has a negative ROI historically.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Taking Broncos +1.5. Chiefs receiver corps is thin and Travis Kelce is aging.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Bears at Seahawks (-3). Line priced accurately, passing on both.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Discord Group Bet announcement: Minnesota Vikings +3.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Underdog Moneyline Parlay & Favorites Moneyline Parlay selections.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Simon's Biggest Bets of the week: Panthers +3.5, Vikings +3.5, Jets -1.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Sharp vs Square: Chad selects Ravens +3.5, Simon selects Bucs -2.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Wrap-up, subscription call to action, and Milwaukee Brewers World Series celebration video clip.

analysis_notes.summary: Chicago Bears traded two 1st-round draft picks and a 4th-round pick to acquire defensive tackle Jeffrey Simmons.
analysis_notes.speaker: Chad Millman
analysis_notes.quote: The Chicago Bears have traded two first round picks and a fourth round pick for Jeffrey Simmons.

analysis_notes.summary: Simon corrected a prior statement: Jared Goff has completed 75% of his passes against the blitz this season.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: Jared Goff, he's great against the blitz... 75% completion percentage against the blitz this year.

analysis_notes.summary: Baker Mayfield injured his throwing hand rather than his non-throwing hand as originally thought.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: Baker Mayfield did hurt his throwing hand.

analysis_notes.summary: Over the past 9 seasons, backing Patrick Mahomes as a spread favorite when receiving >51% of tickets results in a -$1300 return per $100 bet.
analysis_notes.speaker: Chad Millman
analysis_notes.quote: Patrick Mahomes is ranked 101st when he is a favorite getting the majority of the tickets... you would be down $1300.
